title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A multi-page personal site built with semantic HTML and modern CSS, featuring a dynamic project gallery driven by a JSON data file and a dark/light color scheme toggle.

title: Data Structures Library
description: Implemented core data structures in Java — dynamic array, linked list, stack, queue, and hash map — with unit tests and complexity analysis for each operation.

title: Library Quietness Study
description: A comprehensive assessment of the study environment and library quietness paradigm. This initiative was undertaken to leverage key learnings around acoustic excellence.

title: Sentiment Analyzer
description: Trained a Naive Bayes classifier on movie reviews to predict positive or negative sentiment, achieving 84% accuracy on a held-out test set.

title: Persuasive Graphs
description: I have leveraged data visualization best practices to enhance alignment around key messaging and driving more impactful narrative synergy across the communication environment.

title: Personal Budget Tracker
description: A single-page app for logging expenses and income, with category breakdowns, a monthly summary chart, and local-storage persistence between sessions.

title: Weather Evaulation Survey
description: Recommends locations based on user ratings using collaborative filtering, modeled against a synthetic dataset of ten thousand rating records.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: Pulls current conditions and a seven-day forecast from a public weather API and displays them with dynamic icons that change by condition and time of day.

title: Air Quality Predictor
description: A mobile app with widgets showing air quality, with changing icons, habit recommendations, and offline support predicted via saved databases.

title: Calendar Scheduler
description: A constraint-satisfaction solver that generates conflict-free plans from a list of user-estimated time restrictions, with flexible balancing and suggested cutoffs.

title: Image Classifier for Plant Species
description: A convolutional neural network trained on a labeled leaf dataset to classify plant species, with a small web interface for uploading and testing new images.

title: Group Finder
description: A lightweight matching tool that pairs users by category, availability, and special preferences, built as a bot on Discord.
